welcomeEntry.declareGabonese: I declare that I am a Gabonese national.
welcomeEntry.title: Welcome to DIASPORA
welcomeEntry.lead: Check what members will see about you, then enter: one step is enough.
welcomeEntry.idnConsulateCheck: DIASPORA checks with Consulat.ga whether your digital identity is linked to a consular account. If it is, your account automatically becomes Level 2 (verified).
welcomeEntry.consent: When you create your profile, your display name, your handle and your country become visible to DIASPORA members; the directory and notifications stay off until you turn them on.

firstChoices.title: Your choice, now or later
firstChoices.lead: Nothing was turned on for you. Each choice is a separate step, which you also find in your settings.
